usageNote: 名词短语，说的是一伙一起出行的人，旅游团或背包客团体都能用，超日常！

examples.en: A group of travellers arrived at the hotel late at night.
examples.zh: 一群旅行者深夜抵达了酒店。

examples.en: We met a group of travellers who were hiking across the mountains.
examples.zh: 我们遇到了一群正在徒步穿越山脉的旅行者。
